questions.en: Have you made any crafts with paper?
questions.zh: 你用纸做过手工吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I've folded paper flowers before. My favourite part was opening the last fold and seeing a whole flower appear from a plain square of paper.
questions.sampleZh: 折过，我以前折过纸花。我最喜欢最后把折好的纸展开的那一刻，一张普普通通的方纸就变成了一朵完整的花。

questions.en: Do you still write physical letters?
questions.zh: 你现在还写纸质信吗？
questions.sample: Very rarely these days. I send most news by message, but if a friend is moving away, a handwritten letter feels worth the extra effort.
questions.sampleZh: 现在很少写了。平时有什么新鲜事，我大多发消息告诉别人。不过，要是有朋友要搬去别的地方，我觉得多花点心思手写一封信也值得。

questions.en: Do people keep handwritten letters?
questions.zh: 人们会把手写信留起来吗？
questions.sample: I think quite a few people do. A letter fits into a drawer, and seeing a friend's handwriting years later feels different from scrolling through old messages.
questions.focusWording: Do people keep handwritten letters?
questions.sampleZh: 我觉得还挺多人会留着的。一封信收进抽屉就好了，过几年再看到朋友的笔迹，和在手机上翻以前的聊天记录，感觉很不一样。

questions.en: Do you ever take some paper and a pen with you when you go out?
questions.zh: 你出门时会带上一些纸和一支笔吗？
questions.sample: I usually have a pen, but I don't carry a notebook everywhere. If I hear a useful English expression on the bus, I type it into my phone.
questions.sampleZh: 我一般会带一支笔，但不会去哪儿都带着本子。如果我在公交车上听到一个实用的英语表达，就打在手机里记下来。

questions.en: Do you prefer writing letters by hand or sending messages?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢手写信还是发消息？
questions.sample: I prefer sending messages for everyday things, especially if I'm arranging dinner. But if someone writes me a proper letter, I'll sit down and answer it by hand.
questions.focusWording: Do you prefer writing letters by hand or sending messages?
questions.sampleZh: 日常的小事我更喜欢发消息，尤其是和人约饭的时候。不过，要是有人认真写了一封信给我，我也会坐下来，亲手回一封。

questions.en: Did you enjoy using paper to make things when you were a child?
questions.zh: 你小时候喜欢用纸做东西吗？
questions.sample: I loved making little paper boats as a child. I'd fold two out of the same notebook page, float them in a basin and see which one stayed afloat longer.
questions.focusWording: Did you ever make things out of paper when you were a child?
variants: What did you like to do with paper as a child?
questions.sampleZh: 我小时候特别喜欢折小纸船。我会用笔记本里的一张纸折出两只船，放进水盆里，比比看哪一只浮得更久。

questions.en: Do you recycle paper?
questions.zh: 你会回收废纸吗？
questions.sample: I do, although I often reuse it first. I write speaking prompts on the blank side of old printouts and recycle them when both sides are full.
questions.focusWording: Do you recycle paper?
questions.sampleZh: 会，不过我通常会先把纸再利用一次。我会把口语提示词写在旧打印纸空白的那一面，等两面都写满了才拿去回收。

questions.en: Have you ever written a letter on paper?
questions.zh: 你用纸写过信吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I've written thank-you letters by hand. I usually start with one thing the person actually did for me, which makes the letter much easier to write.
questions.sampleZh: 写过，我手写过感谢信。我一般会先写对方具体帮过我的一件事，有了这个开头，整封信就好写多了。

questions.en: Do most people recycle paper where you live?
questions.zh: 你住的地方，大多数人会回收废纸吗？
questions.sample: Quite a few do, especially with cardboard boxes from deliveries. I often see people flattening the boxes before putting them beside the recycling bins.
questions.sampleZh: 挺多人都会回收，尤其是快递用的纸箱。我常看到有人先把纸箱压扁，再放到回收桶旁边。

questions.en: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
questions.zh: 你多久吃一次水果和蔬菜？
questions.sample: I have vegetables with lunch and dinner most days. Fruit is a bit less regular, but if I keep a few oranges on my desk, I remember to eat them.
questions.focusWording: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
questions.sampleZh: 大多数时候，我午餐和晚餐都会吃蔬菜。吃水果就没那么规律了，不过如果桌上摆着几个橙子，我就会想起来吃。

questions.en: Where would you go to buy fruit and vegetables?
questions.zh: 你会去哪里买水果和蔬菜？
questions.sample: I'd go to a market near home if I had time. I like being able to pick a few tomatoes myself instead of buying a whole prepacked box.
questions.sampleZh: 有时间的话，我会去家附近的菜市场。我喜欢自己挑几个西红柿，不用一下买一整盒已经包装好的。

questions.en: What fruits and vegetables do you dislike?
questions.zh: 你不喜欢哪些水果和蔬菜？
questions.sample: I'm not keen on bitter melon, even when it's cooked well. I'm much less picky about fruit, although I usually leave very sour oranges for someone else.
questions.focusWording: What fruits and vegetables do you dislike?
questions.sampleZh: 我不太喜欢苦瓜，就算做得很好吃也不怎么喜欢。水果我倒没那么挑，不过碰到特别酸的橙子，我一般会留给别人吃。

questions.en: Did you dislike any fruits or vegetables when you were a child?
questions.zh: 小时候，你不喜欢吃哪些水果或蔬菜？
questions.sample: I really didn't like bitter melon as a child. I remember trying to hide the pieces under my rice, but the taste still came through.
questions.focusWording: Did you dislike eating any vegetables when little?
questions.sampleZh: 我小时候真的很不喜欢苦瓜。我记得自己还试过把苦瓜块藏在米饭底下，可吃起来那股苦味还是盖不住。

questions.en: Do people in your country like planting vegetables?
questions.zh: 你们国家的人喜欢种蔬菜吗？
questions.sample: Some people really do, especially if they have a little outdoor space. Even in a flat, you can grow spring onions in a pot and use them when you cook.
questions.sampleZh: 有些人确实很喜欢种菜，尤其是家里有一小块露天空间的人。就算住公寓，也能用花盆种点小葱，做饭时随手就能用。

questions.en: Do many people in your country grow their own fruit and vegetables?
questions.zh: 你们国家有很多人自己种水果和蔬菜吗？
questions.sample: Quite a few people with a garden do. In cities, I think growing herbs or a few vegetables on a balcony is more practical than growing enough for every meal.
questions.sampleZh: 有花园的人里，不少人会自己种。在城市里，我觉得在阳台上种些香草或蔬菜挺实际的，但要种够每顿饭吃的量就难多了。

questions.en: Where do people usually buy vegetables?
questions.zh: 人们通常去哪里买蔬菜？
questions.sample: People around me buy vegetables from supermarkets, open markets and delivery apps. The market is useful if you only want a single pepper or a handful of mushrooms.
questions.focusWording: Where do people usually buy vegetables?
questions.sampleZh: 我身边的人会去超市、露天菜市买菜，也会用买菜软件。要是只想买一个甜椒或一小把蘑菇，去菜市场就很方便。

questions.en: When you were a child, how did you learn to be polite?
questions.zh: 你小时候是怎样学会待人有礼的？
questions.sample: I learned a lot by watching the adults at school. When the teacher borrowed a pencil, she thanked the child by name, and soon we were doing the same thing.
questions.focusWording: How did you learn about politeness when you were a child?
questions.sampleZh: 我在学校观察大人怎么做，学到了不少。老师跟哪个孩子借了铅笔，就会叫着名字向对方道谢，过了一阵我们也学着这么做。

questions.en: Do you think being polite is important?
questions.zh: 你觉得有礼貌很重要吗？
questions.sample: Yes, it makes everyday conversations easier, especially when someone is busy. In a shop, asking whether an assistant is free before starting a long question can make a real difference.
questions.focusWording: Do you think being polite is important?
questions.sampleZh: 重要，特别是对方忙的时候，有礼貌能让交流更顺畅。比如进店要问一个挺复杂的问题，先问店员现在方不方便，聊天的感觉就会好很多。

questions.en: When do you think people need to be most polite?
questions.zh: 你觉得人们什么时候最需要讲礼貌？
questions.sample: I'd say when they disagree or have to complain. It's easy to be polite when everything goes well, but a calm tone matters much more when there's a problem.
questions.focusWording: When do you need to be polite?
questions.sampleZh: 我觉得是和别人意见不一致，或者有事要投诉的时候。一切顺利时客气一点很容易，真正遇到问题时，保持平和的语气就更重要了。

questions.en: What did you do to show your politeness as a child?
questions.zh: 你小时候会怎样表现出礼貌？
questions.sample: I used to wait for my turn instead of interrupting. If someone lent me something, I tried to give it back myself and thank them properly.
questions.sampleZh: 我小时候会等轮到自己再说话，不随便打断别人。要是谁借了我东西，我会尽量亲手还回去，再好好说声谢谢。

questions.en: Have you met someone recently who was very polite?
questions.zh: 你最近遇到过特别有礼貌的人吗？
questions.sample: Yes, a shop assistant waited patiently while I changed my mind about an order. She didn't rush me even though there were other people behind me.
questions.focusWording: Have you met anyone very polite recently?
questions.sampleZh: 有。前不久在一家店里，我下单时又改了主意，店员一直耐心地等我。尽管后面还有人在排队，她也没催我。

questions.en: If you thought a friend was being impolite, would you say something to them?
questions.zh: 如果你觉得朋友不太礼貌，会开口提醒吗？
questions.sample: I would, but I'd mention it quietly afterwards. I'd tell my friend how it sounded to me, especially if they hadn't realised the other person was upset.
questions.sampleZh: 会，不过我会等过后再私下提醒。我会告诉朋友，那句话在我听来是什么感觉，特别是在朋友还没意识到对方已经不高兴的时候。

questions.en: How much do you remember about your first day at secondary school?
questions.zh: 中学开学第一天的事，你还记得多少？
questions.sample: I remember looking for my classroom and worrying that everyone else already knew each other. By lunchtime I'd found someone to sit with, and the day got much easier.
questions.focusWording: Do you remember your first day at secondary school?
questions.sampleZh: 我记得自己当时在找教室，还担心其他同学是不是早就互相认识了。到午饭时，我已经找到可以一起坐的同学，接下来一天就轻松多了。

questions.en: Were there any subjects you found difficult or disliked at secondary school?
questions.zh: 你中学时有哪些科目觉得难，或者不太喜欢？
questions.sample: I struggled with physics, especially when I had to work out which formula to use. A diagram usually helped me understand what was happening before I tried the calculation.
questions.focusWording: Were there any subjects that you found difficult (or disliked) at secondary school?
variants: Were there any subjects that you didn't like studying at secondary school?
questions.sampleZh: 我学物理比较吃力，特别是要判断该用哪个公式的时候。我一般先画个图，弄清楚发生了什么，再试着去算。

questions.en: What was your favourite subject at secondary school?
questions.zh: 你中学时最喜欢哪门课？
questions.sample: Art was my favourite subject. We could all draw the same object and end up with completely different pictures, which made looking around the classroom quite interesting.
questions.sampleZh: 我最喜欢美术课。同一个东西，全班画出来却能完全不同，所以看一圈大家的作品就很有意思。

questions.en: Is there anything you miss about your secondary school?
questions.zh: 你怀念中学生活的哪些方面？
questions.sample: I miss the short breaks between classes. My friends and I could talk about lunch or homework for five minutes without having to arrange a time to meet.
questions.sampleZh: 我怀念课间那几分钟。不用特意约时间，就能和朋友聊上五分钟，说说午饭想吃什么，或者作业写得怎么样。

questions.en: Would you recommend your secondary school to other people?
questions.zh: 你愿意向别人推荐自己的中学吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I would. What I remember best is that the teachers took questions seriously, even when someone needed a second explanation of a fairly simple point.
questions.focusWording: Would you recommend your secondary school to others? Why?
questions.sampleZh: 会，我愿意推荐。让我印象最深的是老师会认真对待学生的问题。哪怕一个知识点挺简单，有人需要再听一遍，老师也愿意再讲。

questions.en: Who did you like the most when you were in high school?
questions.zh: 你上高中时最喜欢谁？
questions.sample: My art teacher comes to mind. She used to put two drawings side by side and ask what we noticed before giving us her own opinion.
questions.focusWording: Who did you like the most when you were in high school?
questions.sampleZh: 我首先想到的是美术老师。她常把两幅画并排摆出来，先问我们观察到了什么，再说自己的看法。

questions.en: What did you enjoy most about secondary school?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢中学生活的哪一点？
questions.sample: I enjoyed seeing the same friends every day. We had our favourite seats at lunch, and even a fairly ordinary school day usually gave us something to laugh about.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢每天都能见到那群朋友。午饭时我们有各自喜欢坐的位置，就算是很普通的一天，也总能找到点好笑的事一起乐一乐。

questions.en: Do you like buying shoes? How often?
questions.zh: 你喜欢买鞋吗？多久买一次？
questions.sample: I like looking at shoes more than buying them. I usually get a new pair when my everyday trainers start to wear out, rather than whenever a new style appears.
questions.focusWording: Do you like buying shoes? How often?
questions.sampleZh: 比起买鞋，我更喜欢看鞋。我平时穿的运动鞋快磨坏了才会买新的，不会每次一出新款就买。

questions.en: Have you ever bought shoes online?
questions.zh: 你在网上买过鞋吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I have. I check reviews by people who mention the fit, because a photo tells me very little about how my feet will feel after an hour.
questions.focusWording: Have you ever bought shoes online?
questions.sampleZh: 买过。我会专门看那些提到合不合脚的评价，光看照片，几乎想象不出这双鞋穿一小时后脚会不会难受。

questions.en: How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
questions.zh: 你买鞋通常花多少钱？
questions.sample: I'd usually allow a few hundred yuan for everyday trainers. I compare the soles and the fit before paying, because a cheap pair isn't much of a bargain if it hurts.
questions.focusWording: How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
questions.sampleZh: 买平时穿的运动鞋，我一般会留出几百元预算。付钱前我会比较鞋底，也会试试合不合脚，再便宜的鞋，穿得脚疼也不划算。
questions.sampleNote: 金额可以按自己的预算调整。

questions.en: Do you prefer to wear fashionable shoes or comfortable shoes?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢穿时髦的鞋还是舒适的鞋？
questions.sample: Comfortable ones, without a doubt. A pair can look lovely in the shop, but if I can't get through an afternoon of walking in them, I'll never reach for them.
questions.focusWording: Which do you prefer, fashionable shoes or comfortable shoes?
questions.sampleZh: 我肯定选舒服的鞋。一双鞋摆在店里可能很好看，但要是连穿着走一下午都做不到，我平时就不会想穿它。

questions.en: Do you often wear trainers when you're not doing exercise?
questions.zh: 不运动时，你也常穿运动鞋吗？
questions.sample: Yes, they're probably my first choice for an ordinary day. They're comfortable on the metro, and I don't need to change shoes if I feel like walking home.
questions.sampleZh: 会，平常出门我大概最先想到的就是运动鞋。坐地铁穿着舒服，临时想走回家也不用换鞋。

questions.en: Would you ever pay a lot for a pair of shoes?
questions.zh: 你愿意花很多钱买一双鞋吗？
questions.sample: Only if I had a particular reason, like needing really good walking shoes. I wouldn't pay a lot just for a logo that people might recognise.
questions.sampleZh: 得有个特别的理由，比如我确实需要一双适合长时间走路的好鞋。光凭别人可能认得鞋上的标志，我不会花那么多钱。

questions.en: Did you get many opportunities to try new activities when you were at school?
questions.zh: 小时候上学时，你有很多机会尝试新活动吗？
questions.sample: Yes, school gave me chances to try activities outside class. I enjoyed group projects in particular, because I could find out whether I liked something before committing to it.
questions.sampleZh: 有，学校给了我不少参加课外活动的机会。我特别喜欢小组项目，因为可以先试试看自己喜不喜欢，再决定要不要长期投入。

questions.en: Should people try as many different things as they can?
questions.zh: 人们应该尽可能多地尝试不同的事物吗？
questions.sample: Trying different things is useful, but I'd leave time to stick with one of them. You don't really find out whether you enjoy something after just one afternoon.
questions.sampleZh: 尝试不同的事很有用，不过我也会留出时间，选其中一件坚持做下去。光试一个下午，往往还不知道自己究竟喜不喜欢。

questions.en: Do you like taking on new opportunities?
questions.zh: 你喜欢把握新的机会吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially if I can try something with my hands. I once joined a printing workshop and came home with a postcard I'd made from start to finish.
questions.sampleZh: 通常喜欢，尤其是能亲自动手试一试的机会。有一次我参加了印刷体验活动，带回家一张从头到尾自己做的明信片。

questions.en: Do you often get new opportunities?
questions.zh: 你经常遇到新的机会吗？
questions.sample: They come in bursts for me. One project might lead to an invitation from a teammate, while at other times I have to go looking for an opportunity myself.
questions.sampleZh: 对我来说，机会有时会一下子来好几个。做完一个项目，队友可能就来邀请我参加下一个。但有些时候，也得我自己主动去找。

questions.en: Would you like to have more new opportunities?
questions.zh: 你希望有更多新机会吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I'd love to work with people who do something quite different from me. Helping someone organise a small exhibition would be a good way to learn how events run.
questions.focusWording: Would you like to have more new opportunities?
questions.sampleZh: 想，我很希望有机会和做不同事情的人合作。要是能帮忙筹办一个小展览，我就能看看一场活动到底是怎么组织起来的。

questions.en: How do you feel when you get the opportunity to try new food?
questions.zh: 遇到尝试新食物的机会时，你有什么感受？
questions.sample: I'm usually keen to give it a go. If a friend recommends a dish I've never heard of, I'd rather share one portion and find out what it's like.
questions.sampleZh: 一般我都很想试试。如果朋友推荐一道我连名字都没听过的菜，我更愿意和朋友合点一份，亲口尝尝是什么味道。

questions.en: Would you always take an opportunity to try a new job?
questions.zh: 每次有机会尝试新工作，你都会抓住吗？
questions.sample: No, I'd first ask what an ordinary shift looks like. I'd consider a change if I could learn a useful skill, but a different job title alone wouldn't persuade me.
questions.sampleZh: 不会，我会先问问平时上班都做些什么。如果能学到有用的技能，我会考虑换工作，光换个头衔可打动不了我。

questions.en: Is it important to you to look for new opportunities in life?
questions.zh: 在生活中主动寻找新机会，对你重要吗？
questions.sample: Yes, because it's easy to miss things if I just wait for someone to ask me. I found a free workshop once by stopping to read a noticeboard on my way home.
questions.sampleZh: 重要，光等着别人来找我，很容易错过一些事情。有一次我回家途中停下来看公告栏，才发现有个免费的体验活动。

questions.en: What opportunities have you had?
questions.zh: 你有过哪些机会？
questions.sample: I've had a chance to help with a shop window and to try printmaking at a weekend workshop. The window taught me how much people notice small details from outside.
questions.focusWording: What opportunities have you had?
questions.sampleZh: 我有过帮忙布置商店橱窗的机会，也在周末体验班试过版画。布置橱窗让我发现，路人站在外面也会注意到不少小细节。

questions.en: Are new opportunities important to you?
questions.zh: 新的机会对你个人来说重要吗？
questions.sample: Yes, a chance to try something briefly can tell me more than reading about it. I didn't know I enjoyed printing until I made my first card at a workshop.
questions.focusWording: Are new opportunities important to you?
questions.sampleZh: 重要，亲手试一会儿，常常比光看介绍更能让我了解一件事。我在体验班印出第一张卡片时，才发现自己挺喜欢印刷。

questions.en: What do you do when you see rubbish on the street?
questions.zh: 你看到街上有垃圾时会怎么做？
questions.sample: If it's a clean wrapper and there's a bin nearby, I'll put it in. I leave sharp or dirty things alone and let the cleaning staff know if necessary.
questions.sampleZh: 如果是个干净的包装袋，附近又有垃圾桶，我就会捡起来扔进去。碰到尖锐或很脏的东西，我不会去碰，必要时会告诉保洁人员。

questions.en: How do you recycle things like paper and plastic?
questions.zh: 你怎样回收纸张、塑料这类物品？
questions.sample: I flatten cardboard boxes and put empty plastic bottles in the recycling bin. If a piece of paper has a blank side, I usually write on it first.
questions.sampleZh: 我会把纸箱压扁，把空塑料瓶放进回收桶。纸如果还有一面是空白的，我通常会先拿来写字。

questions.en: Is waste sorting common in your country?
questions.zh: 在你们国家，垃圾分类普遍吗？
questions.sample: It's quite common in places I've lived, especially in larger residential buildings. Whether people sort everything correctly is another question, because some of the labels can be confusing.
questions.sampleZh: 在我住过的地方，垃圾分类挺常见的，尤其是在规模较大的住宅楼里。大家能不能分对就不一定了，因为有些分类标识确实容易让人弄混。

questions.en: Did you recycle when you were a kid?
questions.zh: 你小时候会回收垃圾吗？
questions.sample: A little. At school we collected used paper in a box, and I often took a couple of sheets out again when I needed something to draw on.
questions.sampleZh: 会一点。我们在学校把废纸收进一个盒子里，我想画画的时候，经常又会从里面拿两张出来用。

questions.en: Do you usually recycle your rubbish?
questions.zh: 你平时会回收利用垃圾吗？
questions.sample: Yes, usually paper, cardboard and plastic bottles. Keeping a separate bag for them near the door makes it easier to remember when I go downstairs.
questions.focusWording: Do you recycle rubbish?
questions.sampleZh: 会，通常是回收纸、硬纸板和塑料瓶。我会在门边专门放个袋子装这些东西，这样下楼时就容易记得带上。

questions.en: How is the recycling service in your community?
questions.zh: 你所在社区的垃圾回收服务怎么样？
questions.sample: It's fairly convenient for everyday things like paper and bottles. For something unusual, like an old electronic device, I'd have to look up where to take it.
questions.focusWording: How is the recycling service in your community?
questions.sampleZh: 回收纸和瓶子这类日常物品挺方便的。要是旧电子设备这种不太常见的东西，我就得先查查应该送到哪里去。

questions.en: Did you learn about recycling when you were at school?
questions.zh: 你在学校学过有关垃圾回收的知识吗？
questions.sample: Yes, in small practical ways. Our teachers got us to use the backs of worksheets, and that habit has stayed with me when I print things for studying.
questions.focusWording: Did you learn about recycling when you were at school?
questions.sampleZh: 学过，都是从一些实用的小事学起的。老师会让我们用练习纸的背面写字，我现在打印学习资料时还保留着这个习惯。

questions.en: Do you think there will be more rubbish in the future?
questions.zh: 你觉得将来的垃圾会更多吗？
questions.sample: There could be, especially with all the deliveries people order. A small purchase sometimes comes in a big box, so better packaging would make a real difference.
questions.focusWording: Do you think there will be more rubbish in the future?
questions.sampleZh: 有可能，尤其是现在大家经常收快递。有时买个很小的东西，却用一个大箱子装，改进包装就能起到不小的作用。

questions.en: Are rubbish collection services good where you live now?
questions.zh: 你住的地方，垃圾清运服务好吗？
questions.sample: They're reasonably good in my area. The bins seem to be emptied regularly, although the ones near busy food shops can fill up very quickly in the evening.
questions.sampleZh: 我住的这一带，垃圾清运做得还不错。看起来垃圾桶都会定期清空，不过到了晚上，生意好的餐馆附近的垃圾桶很快就会装满。

questions.en: How do you feel when you see rubbish lying in the street?
questions.zh: 看见街上散落的垃圾时，你是什么感受？
questions.sample: It bothers me, especially if there's a bin a few steps away. One dropped cup is a small thing, but it makes an otherwise pleasant street look neglected.
questions.sampleZh: 我看了会觉得不舒服，尤其是垃圾桶明明就在几步之外。地上一个被人丢下的杯子看着是小事，却能让原本挺舒服的一条街显得没人打理。

questions.en: Would you ever pick up rubbish in a beautiful place?
questions.zh: 你会在风景优美的地方捡垃圾吗？
questions.sample: Yes, if I could do it safely. I'd pick up an empty bottle on a walking path, for example, because it spoils the view for everyone else.
questions.sampleZh: 会，只要捡起来是安全的。比如步道上有个空瓶子，我就会捡走，因为留在那里也影响其他人看风景。

questions.en: Do you find it easy to remember people's names?
questions.zh: 你觉得记住别人的名字容易吗？
questions.sample: One name at a time is fine, but a whole group is harder. I usually remember what we talked about before I remember exactly what the person was called.
questions.focusWording: Is it easy for you to remember people's names?
questions.sampleZh: 一次只认识一个人还好，一下认识一群人就难多了。我一般先想起我们聊过什么，然后才想起那个人到底叫什么。

questions.en: What do you do to help yourself remember people's names?
questions.zh: 你用什么办法帮自己记住别人的名字？
questions.sample: I try to say the name once while we're talking. Later, I connect it with a detail, like the project they mentioned or where we first met.
questions.focusWording: How do you usually remember new names?
questions.sampleZh: 聊天的时候，我会试着叫一次对方的名字。之后我再把名字跟一个小细节联系起来，比如对方提到的项目，或者我们第一次见面的地方。

questions.en: How do you feel when people forget your name?
questions.zh: 别人忘了你的名字时，你有什么感受？
questions.sample: It doesn't bother me much, especially if we've only spoken once. I usually say my name again and mention where we met so they have something to connect it with.
questions.sampleZh: 我不太介意，尤其是我们只聊过一次的时候。我一般会再说一遍自己的名字，顺便提一下我们在哪儿见过，这样对方比较容易想起来。

questions.en: Do you often forget people's names?
questions.zh: 你经常忘记别人的名字吗？
questions.sample: Sometimes, especially after a group meeting. Two people may tell me their names within seconds of each other, and then I get home and mix them up.
questions.sampleZh: 有时候会，尤其是刚参加完小组会议的时候。可能两个人前后才隔几秒就跟我说了名字，等我回到家，就把两个人的名字弄混了。

questions.en: Do you think it is important to remember people's names?
questions.zh: 你认为记住别人的名字重要吗？
questions.sample: Yes, it shows that you paid attention. If someone remembers my name at a second meeting, I feel much more comfortable starting a conversation with them.
questions.focusWording: Do you think it is important to remember people's names?
questions.sampleZh: 重要，这说明你当时认真听了。如果第二次见面，对方还能记得我的名字，我会觉得和对方聊起来更自在。

questions.en: What would you do if someone cannot remember your name?
questions.zh: 如果有人记不住你的名字，你会怎么做？
questions.sample: I'd introduce myself again in a natural pause. Giving them a small clue, like the class we shared, usually works better than waiting for them to guess.
questions.focusWording: What would you do if someone cannot remember your name?
questions.sampleZh: 我会趁谈话自然停顿的时候再介绍一下自己。顺便给个小提示，比如我们一起上过哪门课，通常比等对方猜出来更自然。

questions.en: Have you ever felt bad because you couldn't remember a person's name?
questions.zh: 你有没有因为记不起别人的名字而过意不去？
questions.sample: Yes, especially when the other person remembered mine. I found it less awkward to ask straight away than to spend the entire conversation avoiding their name.
questions.sampleZh: 有过，尤其是对方还记得我名字的时候。我发现直接开口问，比整场聊天都刻意避开对方的名字要自然一些。

questions.en: Do you see advertisements when you are on your phone or computer?
questions.zh: 你用手机或电脑时会看到广告吗？
questions.sample: All the time, especially between short videos. Sometimes I only realise a clip is an advert when the person stops telling a story and starts showing a product.
questions.focusWording: Do you see advertisements when you are on your phone or computer?
questions.sampleZh: 经常看到，尤其是在刷短视频的时候。有时视频里那个人讲着讲着突然开始展示产品，我才意识到原来这是一条广告。

questions.en: Is there an advertisement that made an impression on you when you were a child?
questions.zh: 小时候，有哪个广告让你印象很深？
questions.sample: I remember a food advert mainly because of the tune. I couldn't tell you much about the product now, but I could probably still hum the last line.
questions.sampleZh: 我记得有一则食品广告，主要是因为它的配乐。现在要我说那个产品有什么特点，我已经说不出多少了，但最后那一句的调子我大概还能哼出来。

questions.en: Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?
questions.zh: 你在火车或其他公共交通工具上经常看到广告吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially on the metro. I notice the posters while I'm waiting for a train, because for once I'm standing still with nothing much else to look at.
questions.focusWording: Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?
questions.sampleZh: 会，坐地铁时尤其多。我等车时容易注意到海报，因为那会儿难得就站在原地，也没什么别的可看。

questions.en: Do you like advertisements?
questions.zh: 你喜欢广告吗？
questions.sample: Some of them, yes. I like adverts with a good joke, but if the same one keeps interrupting a video, it quickly starts to annoy me.
questions.sampleZh: 有些喜欢。我挺喜欢包袱好笑的广告，不过如果同一个广告总是打断我看的视频，我很快就会烦。

questions.en: What kind of advertising do you like?
questions.zh: 你喜欢什么样的广告？
questions.sample: I like food adverts that show someone actually making the dish. Watching noodles being pulled by hand tells me much more than someone simply saying they're delicious.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢那种会拍出一道菜具体做法的食品广告。看师傅用手把面拉出来，比单听一个人说这面多好吃，更能让我了解这道菜。

questions.en: Have you ever bought something because you've seen the advertisement for it?
questions.zh: 你因为看过某个商品的广告而买过它吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I've tried a snack after seeing it online. The advert got my attention, but I read a few ordinary customers' comments before placing the order.
questions.sampleZh: 买过。我在网上看到过一款零食，后来就买来尝了。广告先吸引了我，不过下单前我还是看了几条普通买家的评价。

questions.en: Are you interested in watching advertisements on the internet?
questions.zh: 你对看网络广告感兴趣吗？
questions.sample: Sometimes, if there's an interesting story or the food looks good. If it's a long advert that appears before something I want to watch, I usually skip it.
questions.focusWording: Are you interested in watching advertisements on the internet?
questions.sampleZh: 有时会，得看故事有没有意思，或者里面的食物看着香不香。如果我想看的视频前面插了一段很长的广告，我一般会跳过。

questions.en: What kinds of advertisements do you dislike?
questions.zh: 你不喜欢哪类广告？
questions.sample: I dislike adverts that make the close button hard to find. Even if the product is interesting, that little trick makes me want to leave the page immediately.
questions.focusWording: What kinds of advertisements do you dislike?
questions.sampleZh: 我不喜欢那种故意把关闭按钮藏起来的广告。哪怕产品本身有点意思，这种小把戏也会让我想马上退出页面。

questions.en: Are there many advertisements between TV programmes in your country?
questions.zh: 在你们国家，电视节目之间的广告多吗？
questions.sample: Yes, there can be quite a few between shows. I tend to watch videos online these days, so I notice adverts on my phone more often than on television.
questions.sampleZh: 挺多的，两个节目之间有时会放不少广告。我现在更多是在网上看视频，所以比起电视广告，我更常留意到手机上的广告。

questions.en: Do you have a favourite advertisement on TV or the internet?
questions.zh: 电视上或网上有你特别喜欢的广告吗？
questions.sample: I like the food adverts that follow a family preparing dinner together. The little sounds of chopping vegetables and setting the table always make me hungry.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢拍一家人一起准备晚饭的食品广告。切菜、摆碗筷时发出的那些细碎的声音，每次听到都让我觉得饿。

questions.en: Would you like a job where you create advertisements?
questions.zh: 你想从事制作广告的工作吗？
questions.sample: I might enjoy working on the pictures for an advert. Getting one idea across in a small space sounds interesting, especially if the result makes someone stop and look.
questions.sampleZh: 我可能会喜欢为广告配图。在不大的画面里把一个想法表达清楚挺有意思的，特别是如果最后能让路过的人停下来看看。

questions.en: Do you often feel tired?
questions.zh: 你经常感到累吗？
questions.sample: Sometimes, particularly after a long afternoon of English practice. Reading is fine for a while, but trying to speak clearly for several rounds takes more energy than I expect.
questions.focusWording: Do you often feel tired?
questions.sampleZh: 有时候会，尤其是练了整整一下午英语之后。看一阵子书还行，但连续练好几轮口语，还要尽量说清楚，比我想象中费精力。

questions.en: What kinds of things make you feel tired?
questions.zh: 哪些事会让你觉得累？
questions.sample: I get tired when I try to do several unrelated jobs at once. If I keep switching between drawing, replying to messages and checking a shopping list, everything seems to take longer.
questions.focusWording: When do you feel tired?
questions.sampleZh: 同时做好几件不相干的事会让我觉得累。如果一会儿画画，一会儿回消息，又去看购物清单，每件事做起来好像都更费时间。

questions.en: What do you do when you feel tired?
questions.zh: 你觉得累时通常会做什么？
questions.sample: I usually put my phone down and go outside for a short walk. Changing rooms isn't always enough, but a little fresh air makes it easier to start again.
questions.focusWording: What do you do when you feel tired?
questions.sampleZh: 我一般会放下手机，出去走一小段路。有时只换个房间还不够，到外面呼吸一点新鲜空气，再回来开始做事就容易些。

questions.en: Have you ever gone out with friends, even when you were feeling tired?
questions.zh: 你有没有明明很累，却还是和朋友一起出去过？
questions.sample: Yes, I have, usually for a quiet dinner. I might be too tired for a busy shopping centre, but sitting down with a friend can actually give me some energy.
questions.sampleZh: 有过，一般是找个安静的地方吃晚饭。我可能累到不想逛热闹的商场，但和朋友坐下来待一会儿，反倒能恢复一点精神。

questions.en: What do you do to stay awake when you're really tired?
questions.zh: 特别累时，你怎样让自己保持清醒？
questions.sample: I stand up, get some water and move around for a few minutes. If I'm still struggling to keep my eyes open, I stop and take a proper break.
questions.sampleZh: 我会站起来，倒点水，活动几分钟。如果这样还是困得睁不开眼，我就停下来，好好休息一下。

questions.en: Do you think people feel less tired as they get older?
questions.zh: 你觉得人年纪越大越不容易累吗？
questions.sample: Not necessarily. I know older people who have plenty of energy, and young people who are exhausted, so I'd look at sleep and daily routines before age.
questions.sampleZh: 不一定。我认识有些年纪大的人精力很充沛，也认识有些年轻人累得够呛。所以我会先看睡眠和日常作息，再考虑年龄。

questions.en: Do you prefer to sit by the window when travelling?
questions.zh: 旅途中你更喜欢坐靠窗的位置吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially on a train. I like watching the view change from city streets to fields, and it gives me a break from looking at a screen.
questions.focusWording: Do you prefer to sit by the window when travelling?
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，尤其是坐火车的时候。我喜欢看着窗外的城市街道渐渐变成田野，眼睛也能趁机休息一下，不用一直盯着屏幕。

questions.en: Did you have a long journey with your family as a child?
questions.zh: 你小时候和家人一起进行过长途旅行吗？
questions.sample: Yes, we once took a train to stay near a lake. I remember counting the tunnels and guessing when we'd see daylight again more clearly than I remember the station names.
questions.focusWording: Did you have a long journey with your family as a child?
questions.sampleZh: 有过，我们曾坐火车去湖边住了一阵子。比起沿途的站名，我更记得数隧道、猜什么时候能再看到亮光的那段路。
questions.sampleNote: 可以换成一次熟悉的家庭旅行。

questions.en: Do you often ride a bicycle?
questions.zh: 你经常骑自行车吗？
questions.sample: Quite often for short trips. If I have a sheet of card or a rolled-up drawing to carry, though, I usually walk or take the bus instead.
questions.sampleZh: 短途出门我挺常骑车。不过如果要拿一张大卡纸或一卷画，我通常就改成走路或坐公交。

questions.en: What transport do you often use when travelling?
questions.zh: 你旅行时通常搭乘什么交通工具？
questions.sample: For trips between cities, my first choice is usually a train. I can sit comfortably, get up for a stretch and arrive quite close to the centre.
questions.sampleZh: 在城市之间旅行，我通常首选火车。坐着舒服，中途可以站起来活动一下，而且到站时离市中心一般也比较近。

questions.en: What do you usually do during a long journey?
questions.zh: 长途旅行中你通常会做些什么？
questions.sample: I download something to listen to before I leave and pack a snack. After a while, though, I usually put everything away and just look out of the window.
questions.focusWording: What do you usually do during a long journey?
questions.sampleZh: 出发前我会下载点路上能听的东西，再带点零食。不过坐了一会儿以后，我通常还是会把东西都收起来，看看窗外。

questions.en: Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢独自旅行还是结伴旅行？
questions.sample: I prefer travelling with one friend. We can talk on the way and order two different dishes to share, but we don't have to organise a whole group.
questions.focusWording: Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢和一个朋友一起旅行。路上有人聊天，吃饭还能点两道不一样的菜分着吃，又不用张罗一大群人的安排。

questions.en: Are you working or are you a student?
questions.zh: 你现在工作了，还是学生？
questions.sample: I'm taking a course in illustration and working part-time in a stationery shop. It's a good balance because I use the materials in class and help customers choose them at work.
questions.focusWording: Are you working or are you a student?
questions.sampleZh: 我在学插画，也在一家文具店做兼职。两边挺互补的，上课时我会用到这些材料，上班时又可以帮顾客挑选。

questions.en: What subjects are you studying?
questions.zh: 你正在学习什么科目？
questions.sample: I'm studying illustration, mainly how to use pictures to tell a simple story. At the moment we're trying to show a change of mood without adding a single line of text.
questions.focusWording: What subjects are you studying? / What is your major?
questions.sampleZh: 我在学插画，主要是怎样用图画讲一个简短的故事。我们最近在练习不用写一个字，只靠画面就让人看出情绪的变化。

questions.en: Do you like your subject? What do you like or dislike about it?
questions.zh: 你喜欢所学的专业吗？你喜欢或不喜欢它的哪些方面？
questions.sample: Yes, I like seeing an idea turn into something I can put on the wall. The slower part is correcting a drawing several times, but the difference is usually worth it.
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，我享受把一个想法变成能挂在墙上的作品。比较慢的是同一幅画有时得改好几次，不过看得见进步，一般就觉得值得了。

questions.en: Why did you choose to study that subject?
questions.zh: 你为什么选择这个专业？
questions.sample: I chose it because a picture can tell a story before anyone reads a word. I wanted to understand how a change in colour or a line of movement could do that.
questions.sampleZh: 我选这个方向，是因为人还没开始读文字，画面就已经能讲故事了。我想弄明白，换种颜色或加一条表现动作的线，为什么就能有这样的效果。

questions.en: Do you think your subject is popular in your country?
questions.zh: 这个专业在你们国家热门吗？
questions.sample: People seem familiar with illustration through magazines and children's books. Fewer know what the course involves until I show them the sketches behind a finished page.
questions.sampleZh: 很多人通过杂志和童书接触过插画。不过说到这门课具体学什么，了解的人就没那么多了，往往得给他们看看成品背后的草图才好解释。

questions.en: Would you like to study a different subject in the future?
questions.zh: 以后你想改学别的专业吗？
questions.sample: I'd like to try photography alongside illustration. Learning to frame a picture through a camera could help me decide what to leave in or out of a drawing.
questions.sampleZh: 我想在学插画的同时试试摄影。从镜头里练习怎么取景，可能也能帮我判断一幅画里该留下什么、舍去什么。

questions.en: Do you have any plans for your studies in the next five years?
questions.zh: 未来五年，你在学业上有什么计划？
questions.sample: Yes, I'd like to finish my current course and learn how to print small books. By the end, I'd love to have a book I could give someone as a present.
questions.sampleZh: 有，我想先上完现在的课，再学学怎么印小册子。到时候，要是能亲手做出一本可以送人的书，我就很开心了。

questions.en: What are the benefits of being your age?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己这个年纪有什么优势？
questions.sample: I can try a part-time job or a short class without making a huge commitment. That's useful because experience sometimes changes my mind about what I thought I'd enjoy.
questions.sampleZh: 我可以先做份兼职，或者上一门短课，不用一开始就作很大的承诺。这对我挺有用的，因为亲身试过之后，我有时才发现自己真正喜欢什么。

questions.en: Do you prefer to study in the morning or in the afternoon?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢早上还是下午学习？
questions.sample: I prefer the morning for drawing because the light at my desk is good. In the afternoon I can still work on notes or tidy up a sketch I've already started.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢早上画画，因为书桌那边的光线比较好。到了下午，我也可以整理笔记，或者继续修改之前打过草稿的画。

questions.en: What technology do you use when you study?
questions.zh: 你学习时会用到哪些技术？
questions.sample: I use my phone to photograph a sketch before I change it. On my laptop I can put two versions side by side and see which one tells the story more clearly.
questions.sampleZh: 改画之前我会用手机给草图拍张照。用笔记本电脑把两个版本放在一起对比，就能看看哪一幅把故事讲得更清楚。

questions.en: Are you looking forward to working?
questions.zh: 你期待参加工作吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I'm looking forward to using what I learn on a project with a real audience. I already work a few shifts in a shop and enjoy hearing what customers think.
questions.sampleZh: 期待，我想把学到的东西用到一个真正有人看的项目里。我已经在店里兼职上几个班次了，也挺喜欢听顾客聊自己的想法。

questions.en: What changes would you like to see in your school?
questions.zh: 你希望学校有哪些改变？
questions.sample: I'd like classes to have a place for students to leave work in progress. It would save us carrying a large drawing home every time it needs another coat of paint.
questions.sampleZh: 我希望教室里能有个地方，让学生存放还没完成的作品。有些大幅的画还得再上一层色，要是能留下来，就不用每次都扛回家了。

questions.en: How much time do you spend on your studies each week?
questions.zh: 你每周花多长时间学习？
questions.sample: Outside class, I spend a few evenings a week drawing and reviewing my notes. If a picture needs time to dry between layers, I work on a second one while I wait.
questions.sampleZh: 除了上课，我每周会拿几个晚上画画、复习笔记。如果一幅画上完色需要等它干，我就趁这段时间画另一幅。

questions.en: What is the most interesting part of your studies?
questions.zh: 你觉得所学内容中最有趣的是什么？
questions.sample: I love seeing how people read the same drawing differently. If three classmates notice the tiny figure in the corner first, I know it has more impact than I expected.
questions.focusWording: What is the most interesting thing about your major?
questions.sampleZh: 我最喜欢看不同的人怎样理解同一幅画。如果三位同学第一眼都注意到角落里的小人，我就知道它比我预想的更抢眼。

questions.en: Is there anything you don't enjoy about your studies?
questions.zh: 你对自己的学业有什么不喜欢的地方吗？
questions.sample: I don't particularly enjoy trimming and measuring paper before I start. It feels slow, but if the edges are uneven, the finished piece never sits properly in its frame.
questions.sampleZh: 我不太喜欢在动笔前量尺寸、裁纸，感觉进度一下慢了下来。可如果边没裁齐，最后装进画框也很难服帖。

questions.en: How do you think you will use what you are studying in the future?
questions.zh: 你觉得以后会怎样运用所学的专业知识？
questions.sample: I'd like to illustrate instructions that are easy to follow. A good drawing could show someone how to fold a paper box without making them read a whole page first.
questions.sampleZh: 我想画那种一看就明白的说明图。比如，一张画得好的图就能告诉别人怎样折纸盒，不用先读完一整页文字。

questions.en: What kind of work do you do?
questions.zh: 你从事什么工作？
questions.sample: I work part-time in a stationery shop while I study. I restock the shelves and help customers compare things like pens and paper when they're choosing materials.
questions.sampleZh: 我一边上课，一边在文具店做兼职。我会给货架补货，也会在顾客挑材料时帮他们比较不同的笔和纸。

questions.en: Why did you choose to do this type of work?
questions.zh: 你为什么选择这份工作？
questions.sample: I wanted a job that fitted around my classes and gave me a reason to talk to people. A stationery shop also sells things I already use, so learning the products was enjoyable.
questions.sampleZh: 我想找份能配合课程时间、又有机会跟人打交道的工作。文具店卖的也是我平时会用的东西，所以熟悉商品的过程也挺有趣。

questions.en: Would you like to do a different job in the future?
questions.zh: 将来你想做一份不同的工作吗？
questions.sample: Eventually, yes. I'd like to draw for books or magazines, although helping customers at the moment is teaching me a lot about how to explain an idea clearly.
questions.sampleZh: 长远来看想换。我希望给书或杂志画插画，不过现在帮顾客选东西，也让我学到了很多怎样把一个想法讲明白的办法。

questions.en: What requirements did you need to meet to get your current job?
questions.zh: 要得到现在这份工作，你需要满足哪些条件？
questions.sample: For the shop job I had to be available for regular shifts and comfortable talking to customers. Knowing a few different kinds of paper helped when I started.
questions.sampleZh: 做这份文具店的工作，我得能按固定班次到岗，也要愿意跟顾客交流。刚开始时，了解几种不同的纸也帮了我不少。

questions.en: What technology do you use at work?
questions.zh: 工作中你会用到哪些技术？
questions.sample: At work I use a till and a small scanner to look up prices. If a colour is missing from the shelf, I can also check whether we have any in stock.
questions.sampleZh: 我上班会用收银机，也会用小型扫描器查价格。如果货架上少了某种颜色，还能查一查仓库里有没有现货。

questions.en: What do you think is the most important at the moment?
questions.zh: 你觉得眼下最重要的事情是什么？
questions.sample: For me, it's keeping enough time for classwork while doing my share at the shop. I write down my shifts first so I can see which evenings are free for drawing.
questions.sampleZh: 对我来说，目前最重要的是既做好店里的工作，也给课程作业留出足够时间。我先把班次记下来，就知道哪些晚上可以用来画画了。

questions.en: What are your plans for work in the next five years? Would you consider working in a different industry?
questions.zh: 未来五年你有什么工作计划？你会考虑转行吗？
questions.sample: I'd like to build up a collection of drawings and try a few small paid projects. I'd consider moving into publishing if I found that working on books suited me.
questions.sampleZh: 我想先积累一批作品，再接几个小的付费项目试试。如果发现做书很适合自己，我会考虑往出版行业发展。

questions.en: Do you miss being a student?
questions.zh: 你怀念学生时代吗？
questions.sample: I'm still a student, so I haven't had to leave that behind. Before this course, though, I did miss having classmates I could show an unfinished idea to.
questions.sampleZh: 我现在还是学生，所以还谈不上离开学生时代。不过在上这门课之前，我确实挺怀念有同学在身边，没完成的想法也能拿给他们看。

questions.en: Who helps you the most? Can you tell me more about that?
questions.zh: 谁给你的帮助最大？能具体说说吗？
questions.sample: My drawing tutor helps me most. When a picture feels wrong, she usually asks me where I want the viewer to look first, and that gives me a place to start.
questions.sampleZh: 帮我最多的是教我画画的老师。有时候一幅画看着不太对，她通常会问我想让观众先看到哪里，我也就知道该从哪儿改了。

questions.en: What do you enjoy most about your job?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢这份工作的哪一点？
questions.sample: I like helping someone find exactly what they need. It's satisfying when a customer tries two pens on a scrap of paper and immediately knows which one feels right.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢帮顾客找到真正合适的东西。看着对方在一张废纸上试两支笔，一下就知道哪支写着顺手，我会觉得挺有成就感。

questions.en: Is there anything you don't enjoy about your job?
questions.zh: 你对自己的工作有什么不喜欢的地方吗？
questions.sample: Restocking lots of almost identical pens can get repetitive. I still have to pay attention, because mixing up two similar colours makes things harder for the next customer.
questions.focusWording: What do you dislike, or find boring or difficult, about your work?
questions.sampleZh: 给许多外观差不多的笔补货有点单调。我还是得留心，如果把两种相近的颜色放错了，下一位顾客挑起来就麻烦了。

questions.en: Do you think you will continue to do this kind of work in the future?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己以后还会继续从事这类工作吗？
questions.sample: Probably for as long as I'm studying. I like helping customers, but eventually I'd like to spend more of my working day making pictures and preparing them for print.
questions.sampleZh: 读书期间大概会继续做。我喜欢帮顾客，不过长远来看，我希望工作时间里能有更多时间用来画画和准备印刷作品。

questions.en: Is the area where you live now busy or quiet?
questions.zh: 你现在住的街区繁忙还是安静？
questions.sample: It's quiet on the smaller streets, but the road near the bus stop gets busy in the morning. I usually take the longer way beside the river if I'm going for a walk.
questions.focusWording: Do you live in a noisy or a quiet area?
questions.sampleZh: 小街上很安静，不过公交站边的那条路早晨会很忙。如果只是出门走走，我一般会绕点路，沿河边散步。

questions.en: Do you like the area that you live in?
questions.zh: 你喜欢自己住的街区吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I like that I can walk to the shops and still find a quiet path by the river. I don't have to travel across the city for an afternoon outside.
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，这里走路就能逛到商店，也能找到一条安静的河边小路。我如果想在户外待一下午，不用为此跑到城市另一头。

questions.en: Where do you like to go in that area?
questions.zh: 你喜欢去附近哪些地方？
questions.sample: I often go to the path beside the river. There's a bench with a view of the bridge, and it's a good spot to practise drawing buildings or just watch the boats.
questions.sampleZh: 我常去河边的小路。那儿有一张能望见桥的长椅，很适合练习画建筑，或者单纯坐着看船。

questions.en: Do you know any of your neighbours?
questions.zh: 你认识自己的邻居吗？
questions.sample: I know a few neighbours by face, especially the people who use the same entrance. We say hello and sometimes help each other carry a heavy parcel upstairs.
questions.focusWording: Do you know any of your neighbours?
questions.sampleZh: 我对几个邻居挺眼熟，尤其是走同一个楼门的那些人。我们碰见会打招呼，偶尔也帮对方把重包裹搬上楼。
questions.sampleNote: 可按自己的情况说说平时怎么和邻居打招呼。

questions.en: Are the people in your neighborhood nice and friendly?
questions.zh: 你住的街区里的人待人友好吗？
questions.sample: Most people I've met have been friendly. We don't spend a lot of time together, but a quick greeting downstairs makes the building feel less anonymous.
questions.sampleZh: 我遇到的大多数人都挺友善的。大家虽然不常一起活动，但在楼下碰面时打个招呼，就会觉得住在这栋楼里的也不全是陌生人。

questions.en: Do you know any famous people in your area?
questions.zh: 你知道附近有什么名人吗？
questions.sample: I don't know anyone famous personally. There's a maker whose work I recognise in shop windows, but I'd probably walk straight past the person without realising who they were.
questions.sampleZh: 我自己不认识什么名人。有位手工艺人的作品我在橱窗里一看就认得，但要是在街上遇到本人，我可能直接就走过去了。

questions.en: What changes have there been in your area recently?
questions.zh: 最近你住的街区有些什么变化？
questions.sample: A stretch of the riverside path has been widened. Now people walking side by side don't have to step off the path whenever a bicycle comes past.
questions.sampleZh: 河边有一段小路拓宽了。现在两个人并排走，碰到有自行车经过，不用每次都迈到路旁去让车。

questions.en: Is the area where you live crowded with people and cars?
questions.zh: 你住的地方人多、车多吗？
questions.sample: Near the bus stop it can be crowded when school finishes. A couple of streets away it's quite different, especially by the water, where there's more room to walk.
questions.focusWording: Is the area where you live crowded (with people and cars)?
questions.sampleZh: 放学时公交站附近人车都不少。往外走两条街，情况就大不一样，特别是水边，走路的地方宽敞多了。

questions.en: Do you know how many people live in your area?
questions.zh: 你知道这一带住了多少人吗？
questions.sample: I don't know the exact figure. Some people live above the shops and others commute in for work, so the number you see on the street changes during the day.
questions.focusWording: Do you know how many people live in your area?
questions.sampleZh: 具体数字我不知道。有些人住在商店楼上，有些人是在这里上班，所以一天里不同时间在街上看到的人也不一样多。

questions.en: Have you lived in this area for a long time?
questions.zh: 你在这个街区住了很久吗？
questions.sample: Yes, about a year. I now recognise the regulars at the corner shop, but every so often my flatmate still shows me a shortcut I didn't know about.
questions.sampleZh: 是，住了大约一年。现在我已经认得街角小店的一些常客，但室友偶尔还是能带我走一条我原来不知道的近路。
questions.sampleNote: 居住时长和日常例子都可以替换。

questions.en: Do you know many people in the area where you live?
questions.zh: 你认识很多住在这一带的人吗？
questions.sample: I know a handful of neighbours and recognise several shopkeepers. It's more a case of familiar faces than close friends, though we often stop for a quick chat.
questions.sampleZh: 我认识几个邻居，也认得几位店主。大家更像是熟面孔，还算不上亲密的朋友，不过碰见时常常会停下来聊两句。

questions.en: Where is your hometown?
questions.zh: 你的家乡在哪里？
questions.sample: I grew up in a small town by the sea. The quickest way to describe it is to picture a harbour with fishing boats and a strip of shops behind it.
questions.focusWording: Where is your hometown?
questions.sampleZh: 我在海边的一座小镇长大。要简单描述它，就想象一个停着渔船的小港口，港口后面有一排商店。

questions.en: Is that a big city or a small place?
questions.zh: 你的家乡是大城市还是小地方？
questions.sample: It's a small town rather than a big city. You can walk from the main shopping street to the harbour before your takeaway coffee gets cold.
questions.sampleZh: 那里是座小镇。你从主要的商业街步行到港口，手里那杯外带咖啡可能都还没凉。
questions.sampleNote: 可用步行距离或生活节奏来说明家乡的大小。

questions.en: What kind of place is it?
questions.zh: 你的家乡是个什么样的地方？
questions.sample: It's a quiet coastal town, apart from the mornings when the boats come in. The sound I remember best is people calling to each other across the water.
questions.focusWording: What kind of place is it?
questions.sampleZh: 那是一座挺安静的海边小镇，早上渔船回港时倒是很热闹。我最记得的是人们隔着水面互相招呼的声音。

questions.en: What's your hometown famous for?
questions.zh: 你的家乡以什么闻名？
questions.sample: People know it for its little harbour and the fish market beside it. Visitors often turn up early to see what the boats have brought in that morning.
questions.sampleZh: 那里比较出名的是小港口和旁边的鱼市。游客常会一大早过去，看渔船当天带回了什么。

questions.en: What do you like most about your hometown?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢家乡的哪一点？
questions.sample: What I like most is how close the water is. When I lived there, a short walk after supper was enough to see whether the tide was coming in or going out.
questions.sampleZh: 我最喜欢家乡离海很近这一点。以前住那里时，晚饭后走一小段路，就能看看是涨潮还是退潮。

questions.en: Do you like living there?
questions.zh: 你喜欢在那里生活吗？
questions.sample: Yes, it was a pleasant place to grow up because I could walk almost everywhere. I live somewhere busier now, so I notice the quiet more when I visit.
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，它很适合长大，几乎去哪儿都能走路。现在我住的地方要热闹些，所以回去看看时，比以前更能感受到那份安静。

questions.en: Is there anything you dislike about it?
questions.zh: 家乡有没有什么地方是你不喜欢的？
questions.sample: There aren't many buses in the evening. If you miss the last one after seeing a friend, the same short journey suddenly turns into quite a long walk.
questions.sampleZh: 晚上可坐的公交车不多。见完朋友要是错过末班车，本来坐车很短的一段路，走回去就得花不少时间。

questions.en: How long have you lived there?
questions.zh: 你在那里生活了多久？
questions.sample: I lived there throughout my childhood and moved out when I started my current course. I still go back for short visits, but it's no longer my everyday base.
questions.focusWording: How long have you lived there?
questions.sampleZh: 我整个童年都在那里生活，开始上现在这门课时才搬出去。我还是会回去小住几天，不过日常已经不住在那里了。
questions.sampleNote: 也可以用 for 加时长、用 since 加起始时间。

questions.en: Do you think you will continue living there for a long time?
questions.zh: 你打算在那里长期生活吗？
questions.sample: I live in the city for now because my classes and part-time job are here. I might return to the coast later, but I don't have a fixed plan yet.
questions.sampleZh: 我现在住在城里，因为上课和做兼职都在这里。以后也许会搬回海边，不过我目前没有定好的计划。

questions.en: Are there many young people in your hometown?
questions.zh: 你的家乡年轻人多吗？
questions.sample: There are quite a few, especially during the holidays when students come home. The basketball court near the harbour is usually a good place to spot people after school.
questions.sampleZh: 挺多的，特别是假期学生都回家的时候。放学以后，港口附近的篮球场通常能见到不少年轻人。

questions.en: Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?
questions.zh: 你觉得家乡适合年轻人发展事业吗？
questions.sample: It depends on the job. Someone interested in sailing or tourism could learn a lot there, but anyone looking for a large publishing company might have to move elsewhere.
questions.sampleZh: 要看工作。想从事航海或旅游的人在那里能学到很多，不过想进大型出版社的人可能就得去别的地方了。

questions.en: Have you learned anything about the history of your hometown?
questions.zh: 你了解过家乡的历史吗？
questions.sample: A little. I once looked at old pictures of the harbour in a small exhibition and realised that a building I knew as a shop had been a storehouse.
questions.sampleZh: 了解一点。我在一个小展览看过港口的老照片，才知道有栋我一直以为是商店的房子以前原来是仓库。

questions.en: Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?
questions.zh: 你在学校学过家乡的历史吗？
questions.sample: Yes, one lesson used an old map of the town. Finding familiar streets on it was much more memorable than learning a list of dates from a book.
questions.sampleZh: 学过，有一堂课老师拿来了镇上的老地图。在上面找出熟悉的街道，比照着书背一串年代让我印象深多了。

questions.en: Did you learn about the culture of your hometown in your childhood?
questions.zh: 你小时候了解过家乡的文化吗？
questions.sample: Yes, at local events when I was a child. Watching people repair fishing nets at a harbour fair taught me more about daily life there than a poster could have done.
questions.sampleZh: 有，我小时候参加本地活动时了解过。在港口集市上看人补渔网，比看宣传海报更让我了解当地人的日常生活。

questions.en: Do you know many people who live nearby?
questions.zh: 你认识许多住在附近的人吗？
questions.sample: I still recognise several people on the street where I grew up. I see them less often now that I live elsewhere, so a short visit usually involves quite a few greetings.
questions.focusWording: Do you know many people who live nearby?
questions.sampleZh: 在我长大的那条街上，我现在还认得好些人。因为住去了别处，我没那么常见到他们了，所以偶尔回去一趟，常得跟不少人打招呼。
questions.sampleNote: 可说说自己怎么和家乡熟识的人保持联系。

questions.en: Who do you live with?
questions.zh: 你和谁一起住？
questions.sample: I share a flat with another student. We have separate rooms, but we sometimes use the kitchen together, especially when both of us get home from class around the same time.
questions.sampleZh: 我和另一位学生合租一套公寓。我们各有自己的房间，有时候会一起用厨房，特别是两个人差不多同时下课回家的时候。
questions.sampleNote: 合住、独居或与家人同住都可以作为回答角度。

questions.en: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
questions.zh: 你现在住的是独立住宅还是公寓？
questions.sample: I live in a flat in a riverside city. It's upstairs from a row of shops, and sharing the rent with a flatmate leaves me enough money for my classes.
questions.focusWording: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
questions.sampleZh: 我住在一座河畔城市的公寓里。楼下是一排商店，我和室友分摊房租，这样还能留出足够的钱上课。
questions.sampleNote: 可按自己的住房类型描述一处具体细节。

questions.en: Can you describe the place where you live?
questions.zh: 你能描述一下自己的住处吗？
questions.sample: It's a small flat with two bedrooms and a shared kitchen. My room gets good light in the morning, so I've put my drawing table next to the window.
questions.sampleZh: 是一套小公寓，有两间卧室，共用厨房。我的房间早上光线好，所以我把画桌放在窗边。
questions.sampleNote: 可用一两处房间布置来说明住处的特点。

questions.en: Are the transport facilities to your home very good?
questions.zh: 你家附近交通方便吗？
questions.sample: Yes, there's a bus stop a short walk from the flat. Most days I can get to class without changing buses, which is useful when I'm carrying a folder of drawings.
questions.sampleZh: 方便，从公寓走一小段路就有公交站。我平时去上课多数时候不用换车，拿着一大夹画稿的时候尤其方便。

questions.en: Do you prefer living in a house or an apartment?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢住独立住宅还是公寓？
questions.sample: At the moment I'd choose a flat. I like being within walking distance of shops and having less space to look after, especially when work and classes are both busy.
questions.sampleZh: 目前我会选公寓。我喜欢走路就能到商店，住处小一点也省得费心打理，特别是上课和上班都忙的时候。

questions.en: How long have you been living in this place?
questions.zh: 你在现在的住处住了多久？
questions.sample: I've lived here for about a year. I remember the move because one of the first things I did was measure the window to see whether my drawing table would fit.
questions.focusWording: How long have you lived there?
questions.sampleZh: 我在这里住了大约一年。我挺记得搬家那会儿，因为刚搬来做的头几件事中，就有量窗边的尺寸，看放不放得下画桌。
questions.sampleNote: 可按实际居住时长替换时间表达。

questions.en: Do you plan to live there for a long time?
questions.zh: 你打算在那里长期住下去吗？
questions.sample: I'd stay for a while, especially while my classes are nearby. If I eventually need more space to work, I'd look for another flat with a bigger room.
questions.sampleZh: 我想再住一阵子，尤其是现在上课的地方也在附近。如果以后需要更宽敞的工作空间，我就会找一套房间大一些的公寓。

questions.en: Please describe the room you live in.
questions.zh: 请描述一下你住的房间。
questions.sample: My room has a bed, a narrow bookshelf and a table by the window. I keep a board above the table for sketches, so they don't take over the floor.
questions.sampleZh: 我房间里有张床、一个窄书架，窗边还有张桌子。我在桌子上方放了块板用来固定草图，就不用把草图摊得满地都是。
questions.sampleNote: 可选自己房间里最常使用的一件家具。

questions.en: What is your favourite room or part of your home?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢家里的哪个房间或角落？
questions.sample: The spot by the window is my favourite. I use it for drawing when the light is good and for listening to a podcast when I've finished for the day.
questions.focusWording: What is your favourite room (or part) of your home?
questions.sampleZh: 我最喜欢窗边那个位置。光线好的时候我在那里画画，一天的事情做完，就坐在那里听听播客。

questions.en: What room does your family spend most of the time in?
questions.zh: 你的家人平时在哪个房间待得最久？
questions.sample: When I visit my family, we spend the most time in the kitchen. Someone is usually making tea or washing up, and the rest of us sit nearby and talk.
questions.sampleZh: 我回家看家人时，大家通常在厨房待得最久。往往有人在泡茶或者洗碗，其他人就坐在旁边聊天。
questions.sampleNote: 可换成自己熟悉的家庭活动空间。

questions.en: What do you usually do in your apartment?
questions.zh: 你在公寓里通常会做些什么？
questions.sample: I do a lot of my English practice there, especially speaking and listening. When I've finished, I usually change the mood by putting on some music or making something to eat.
questions.sampleZh: 我常在家里学英语，尤其是练口语和听力。练完一般会放点音乐，或者做点吃的，换换心情。

questions.en: What makes you feel pleasant in your home?
questions.zh: 在家里，什么让你感觉舒适愉快？
questions.sample: I like being able to close the door after a busy day and have a little time to myself. Something as simple as a warm meal makes a difference too.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢忙了一天以后能关上门，留一点时间给自己。有时很简单，一顿热乎的饭菜，也会让我在家里觉得很舒服。

questions.en: What's the difference between where you live now and where you have lived in the past?
questions.zh: 你现在住的地方和以前的住处有什么不同？
questions.sample: My old room looked straight onto a wall, while this one looks out over rooftops. The extra daylight makes a bigger difference to me than the size of the room.
questions.sampleZh: 我以前的房间窗外正对着一堵墙，现在这间能看到远处的屋顶。对我来说，采光改善比房间大小的变化更重要。
questions.sampleNote: 可以比较两处住所的采光、位置或空间。

questions.en: What kind of house or apartment would you like to live in someday?
questions.zh: 你将来想住什么样的房子或公寓？
questions.sample: I'd choose a flat with large windows and enough space to spread out paper on a table. A balcony would be lovely, even if it only had room for one chair.
questions.sampleZh: 我想选一套窗户大、桌子上能摊开画纸的公寓。要是再有个阳台就更好了，哪怕小到只能放下一把椅子也行。

questions.en: Do you think it is important to live in a comfortable environment?
questions.zh: 你觉得有一个舒适的居住环境重要吗？
questions.sample: Yes, because small things affect you every day. A decent chair and a quiet corner matter more to me when I'm studying than a room that just looks impressive.
questions.sampleZh: 重要，因为小细节每天都会影响到你。我学习的时候，一把坐起来舒服的椅子、一个安静的角落，都比房间看起来多漂亮要重要。

questions.en: What do you like about the place you're living in now?
questions.zh: 你喜欢现在住处的哪些方面？
questions.sample: I like the convenience of the neighbourhood. If I've spent all afternoon at my desk, I can step outside, walk a little and find a proper meal nearby.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢住处周边很方便这一点。如果已经在书桌前坐了一下午，出门走几步，就能在附近找个地方好好吃顿饭。

questions.en: If you could change something about this place, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果能改变住处的某个地方，你想改变什么？
questions.sample: I'd add a shelf just inside the front door. My flatmate and I could leave our keys and shopping bags there instead of taking up space on the kitchen table.
questions.focusWording: Would you like to change anything in your home?
questions.sampleZh: 我会在入户门内侧加一块置物架。我和室友可以把钥匙和购物袋放在那里，就不用占厨房餐桌的位置了。

questions.en: What city do you live in?
questions.zh: 你住在哪座城市？
questions.sample: I live in a small city built along a river. The older shops are on one bank and my classes are on the other, so I cross the bridge most days.
questions.sampleZh: 我住在一座沿河而建的小城。老店铺在河的一边，我上课的地方在另一边，所以大多数日子我都要经过那座桥。

questions.en: How long have you lived in this city?
questions.zh: 你在这座城市住了多久？
questions.sample: I've lived here for about a year, since I started my course. I still come across streets I haven't seen, but the route from my flat to class feels familiar now.
questions.sampleZh: 我从开始上这门课起就在这里住了，大约一年。偶尔还会发现没去过的街，不过从公寓到上课地点的那条路现在已经很熟悉了。
questions.sampleNote: 也可以用搬家后的某个生活变化来说明居住时长。

questions.en: What's the weather like where you live?
questions.zh: 你住的地方天气怎么样？
questions.sample: The wind off the river can make a mild day feel surprisingly cool. I usually take a light jacket if I'm going to sit outside and draw for a while.
questions.sampleZh: 河面上的风有时会让原本温和的天气也变得凉飕飕的。如果打算坐在室外画一会儿，我一般会带件薄外套。

questions.en: Do you like this city? Why?
questions.zh: 你喜欢这座城市吗？为什么？
questions.sample: Yes, I like how easy it is to get around on foot. After class I can cross the bridge, pick up a few groceries and be home without planning a long journey.
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，我很喜欢在这里步行出门很方便。下课后过个桥，顺路买点菜就能回到家，不用专门规划一段很长的路。

questions.en: Have there been any big changes in this city?
questions.zh: 这座城市有什么大的变化吗？
questions.sample: I notice changes in everyday things like new shops and transport routes. Sometimes I go back to a familiar street and find that the entrance I used has moved.
questions.sampleZh: 我注意到的变化都在日常生活里，比如新开的店和变了的交通线路。有时再回到一条熟悉的街，才发现以前一直走的那个入口已经换了位置。

questions.en: Is this city your permanent residence?
questions.zh: 这座城市是你的长期居住地吗？
questions.sample: It's where I live now, but I haven't made a permanent decision. I'd like to finish my course here and see what work is available before choosing where to settle.
questions.sampleZh: 这里是我现在住的地方，不过我还没决定长期定居在哪儿。我想先在这儿上完课，再看看有哪些工作机会，然后决定安顿下来住在哪里。

questions.en: Would you recommend your city to others?
questions.zh: 你会向别人推荐自己的城市吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially to people who enjoy walking. Someone could spend a pleasant afternoon following the river, stopping at a market and looking at the small galleries along the way.
questions.sampleZh: 会，特别是喜欢散步的人。在这里可以花一个下午沿河走走，逛逛市场，再看看路边的小画廊，挺惬意的。

questions.en: Are there people of different ages living in this city?
questions.zh: 这座城市里住着各个年龄段的人吗？
questions.sample: Yes, and you notice it in the parks. Children play, older people chat or exercise, and younger adults often come through on their way home from work.
questions.sampleZh: 有，而且在公园里很容易看到这一点。孩子们在玩，年长的人在聊天、锻炼，年轻的上班族也常在下班回家的路上从这里经过。

questions.en: Are the people friendly in the city?
questions.zh: 这座城市的人友好吗？
questions.sample: Most people I've met have been friendly. When I was new, a shopkeeper drew me a little map on a paper bag so I wouldn't miss the entrance to my class.
questions.sampleZh: 我遇到的大多数人都挺友好。刚来的时候，有位店主在纸袋上帮我画了张小地图，这样我去上课时就不容易错过入口。

questions.en: Is the city friendly to children and old people?
questions.zh: 这座城市适合儿童和老年人生活吗？
questions.sample: Some parts are quite welcoming, especially neighbourhood parks with paths and benches. Busy crossings are harder, so it depends a lot on the particular area and time of day.
questions.sampleZh: 有些地方对孩子和老人挺友好，尤其是那种有步道、沿途又有长椅的社区公园。车多人多的路口就难走一些，所以很大程度上还得看具体是哪里、一天中的什么时间。

questions.en: Do you often see your neighbors?
questions.zh: 你经常见到邻居吗？
questions.sample: Fairly often, usually near the entrance or the lifts. We don't always stop for a long conversation, but we recognise each other and normally say hello.
questions.sampleZh: 挺经常的，一般是在楼栋入口或电梯附近。我们不一定每次都停下来聊很久，但彼此都认得，通常也会打声招呼。

questions.en: Do you often wear a watch?
questions.zh: 你经常戴手表吗？
questions.sample: Not very often. I usually check the time on my phone, although a simple watch would be useful when I want to study without opening any apps.
questions.focusWording: Do you wear a watch?
questions.sampleZh: 不太常戴。我一般用手机看时间，不过要是我想安心学习，又不想打开手机上的任何应用，一块简单的手表就挺有用。

questions.en: Has anyone ever given you a watch as a present?
questions.zh: 有没有人把手表送给你当礼物？
questions.sample: No, I haven't received one as a present. A watch with a simple face would be a thoughtful gift, though, because I'd actually use it during a busy shift.
questions.sampleZh: 没有，我没收过别人送的手表。不过一块表盘简洁的手表会是很贴心的礼物，因为忙着上班的时候我真的用得上。
questions.sampleNote: 可用自己的收礼经历回答，也可以直接说明没有收到过。

questions.en: Why do some people wear expensive watches?
questions.zh: 为什么有些人会戴很贵的手表？
questions.sample: For some people it's a reward for reaching a goal, like getting their first job. Others simply enjoy the design and wear it in the same way as jewellery.
questions.focusWording: Why do some people wear expensive watches?
questions.sampleZh: 对一些人来说，那是给自己达成目标的一份奖励，比如庆祝找到第一份工作。还有些人单纯喜欢手表的设计，把它当作首饰来戴。

questions.en: Do you think it is important to wear a watch?
questions.zh: 你觉得戴手表重要吗？
questions.sample: It depends on the situation. During a meeting, checking a watch feels less distracting than taking out a phone, but on an ordinary day my phone does the job.
questions.focusWording: Do you think it is important to wear a watch?
questions.sampleZh: 看情况。开会时，瞄一眼手表比掏出手机更不容易让人分心，不过平时看看手机就够了。

questions.en: Would you like to receive a watch as a gift?
questions.zh: 你愿意收到一块手表作为礼物吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I'd be happy to receive a simple one. If someone chose a style that suited me, I'd probably remember that person each time I put it on.
questions.focusWording: Would you receive a watch as a gift?
questions.sampleZh: 会，收到一块款式简单的手表我就很开心。如果对方特意挑了适合我的款式，以后每次戴上，我大概都会想起送表的人。

questions.en: Would you spend a lot of money on a watch?
questions.zh: 你愿意花很多钱买一块手表吗？
questions.sample: Probably not. I'd rather spend that money on a trip or a good meal with friends, since even an inexpensive watch can tell me the time.
questions.sampleZh: 大概不会。便宜的手表一样能看时间，我更愿意把这笔钱花在旅行上，或者和朋友好好吃一顿。

questions.en: Do you notice the type of watch that other people are wearing?
questions.zh: 你会留意别人戴什么样的手表吗？
questions.sample: Only if there's something unusual about it, like a bright strap or a very small face. I hardly ever know which brand someone is wearing.
questions.sampleZh: 除非它有什么特别的地方，比如表带颜色很亮，或者表盘特别小，我才会留意。我几乎认不出别人戴的是什么牌子。

questions.en: Would you like to own a really expensive car in the future?
questions.zh: 将来你想拥有一辆很贵的车吗？
questions.sample: Not particularly. If I ever needed a car, I'd choose one that felt safe and comfortable, and I'd rather spend the difference on travelling with friends.
questions.focusWording: Would you like to own a good (expensive) car if you had the chance?
questions.sampleZh: 没有特别想要。如果将来需要买车，我会选一辆让我觉得安全、坐着舒服的，省下来的钱更愿意花在和朋友旅行上。

questions.en: Do you think car colours are important?
questions.zh: 你觉得汽车的颜色重要吗？
questions.sample: A little, because you see the colour every day. I'd choose something fairly simple myself, but the seats and the space inside would matter much more.
questions.sampleZh: 有一点在意，毕竟每天都要看到这个颜色。我自己会选比较素的颜色，不过我更看重座椅舒不舒服、车里的空间大不大。

questions.en: Did you enjoy traveling by car when you were a kid?
questions.zh: 你小时候喜欢坐车出游吗？
questions.sample: Yes, mostly because I could sit by the window and make up stories about the houses we passed. For me, an ordinary road could be more interesting than the destination.
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，主要是因为我能坐在窗边，给一路经过的房子编故事。对那时的我来说，一条普通的路甚至会比目的地更有意思。

questions.en: What types of cars do you like?
questions.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的车？
questions.sample: I like practical cars with comfortable seats and enough room for bags. A fancy screen is nice, but after a few hours I'd care more about the back seat.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢实用的车，座椅要舒服，还要放得下行李。漂亮的大屏幕当然不错，但坐了几个小时以后，我更在意的还是后排座椅舒不舒服。

questions.en: Do you prefer to drive a car or to be a passenger?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢自己开车还是当乘客？
questions.sample: I usually prefer being a passenger. I enjoy finding the route and looking out for the right turning, so I can still help without being the one holding the steering wheel.
questions.focusWording: Do you prefer being a driver or a passenger?
questions.sampleZh: 我一般更喜欢当乘客。我喜欢看路线，也会留意该在哪个路口转弯，这样不用我握方向盘也能帮上忙。
questions.sampleNote: 可以从看风景、认路或通勤习惯说起。

questions.en: What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?
questions.zh: 堵车的时候你通常做什么？
questions.sample: As a passenger, I usually put on music or message whoever is waiting for me. Knowing I've warned them I'm late helps me relax a bit.
questions.sampleZh: 如果是我坐车，我通常会放点音乐，或者给等我的人发个消息。告诉对方我会晚到以后，我自己也能放松一点。

questions.en: Have you ever had a long car journey?
questions.zh: 你有过长途乘车旅行的经历吗？
questions.sample: Yes, a friend once gave me a lift to an exhibition in another town. The drive took long enough for us to finish an entire podcast and still stop for a break.
questions.focusWording: Have you ever had a long car journey?
questions.sampleZh: 有过，朋友曾开车载我去另一个小镇看展览。那段路够长，我们听完了一整期播客，还有时间中途停下来歇一会儿。
questions.sampleNote: 可换成一次熟悉的乘车旅行。

questions.en: When you were a child, did you go on any long car journeys?
questions.zh: 你小时候有没有坐汽车长途旅行过？
questions.sample: Just a few. The one I remember best was a school outing by minibus, where the journey seemed to last longer than the actual visit to the museum.
questions.sampleZh: 有过几次。我印象最深的是学校坐小巴出去参观，那天感觉在车上花的时间比在博物馆里看的时间还长。
questions.sampleNote: 可换成儿时印象深刻的一段车程。

questions.en: Do you think there are too many cars in the area where you live?
questions.zh: 你觉得住处附近的车太多了吗？
questions.sample: Yes, at certain times. Cars queue up near the bridge in the evening, and if I haven't got much to carry, getting out and walking is sometimes quicker.
questions.sampleZh: 有时是。傍晚桥边容易排起车队，要是我没带什么重东西，有时候下车走过去还快一点。

questions.en: Do you enjoy travelling by car?
questions.zh: 你现在喜欢坐车旅行吗？
questions.sample: Usually, especially if someone else is driving and we have time to stop. On a busy weekday, though, I'd choose the metro because the journey is easier to predict.
questions.focusWording: Do you enjoy travelling by car?
questions.sampleZh: 通常喜欢，尤其是有人开车，而且我们有时间在路上停一停的时候。不过，忙碌的工作日我会选地铁，因为路上要花多久比较好估计。

questions.en: Do you prefer to get information from a website or from a book?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢通过网站还是书籍获取信息？
questions.sample: For a quick question, I'd use a website and compare two answers. For a topic I need to study seriously, a book helps me follow the ideas in order.
questions.focusWording: Do you usually get information from websites or from books?
questions.sampleZh: 如果只是一个想赶快弄明白的小问题，我会上网找找，再对照一下两个回答。如果是想认真学的主题，看书更方便我顺着思路一步一步学下去。

questions.en: Would you like to have your own website?
questions.zh: 你想拥有自己的网站吗？
questions.sample: I'd like a simple site one day. I'd put a few drawings side by side, so someone could see the sketches that came before a finished picture.
questions.focusWording: Would you like to have your own website?
questions.sampleZh: 以后我想做一个简单的网站。我会并排放几幅画，让浏览的人能看到一幅成品画之前经历了哪些草稿阶段。

questions.en: What kinds of websites do you often visit?
questions.zh: 你通常会浏览哪些类型的网站？
questions.sample: I visit online catalogues to find illustrations and library pages to check whether a book is available. When I need a break, I sometimes look up exhibitions near me.
questions.sampleZh: 我会逛在线目录找插画，也会上图书馆网站查一本书有没有馆藏。想休息一下时，我有时会看看附近有什么展览。

questions.en: What is your favourite website?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪个网站？
questions.sample: My favourite is a website that lets me look closely at the pages of old picture books. Enlarging a small corner often reveals details I missed at first glance.
questions.sampleZh: 我最喜欢一个能细看老绘本内页的网站。把画面上的小角落放大，常能发现第一眼漏掉的细节。

questions.en: Have there been any changes to the websites you often visit?
questions.zh: 你常去的网站最近有变化吗？
questions.sample: Yes, one of my regular library websites recently made its search filters easier to find. I can now narrow a long list down to books I can actually borrow.
questions.focusWording: Have there been any changes to the websites you often visit?
questions.sampleZh: 有，我常用的一个图书馆网站最近把搜索筛选功能放到了更好找的位置。现在很长的书单也能很快缩小成我实际能借到的那些书。

questions.en: What are the most popular websites in your country?
questions.zh: 你们国家最受欢迎的是哪些网站？
questions.sample: Video and shopping websites are popular in my circle. People might spend an evening watching a series, then use another site to compare prices before buying something.
questions.focusWording: What are the most popular websites in your country?
questions.sampleZh: 我身边的人挺爱用视频网站和购物网站的。有人会花一个晚上追剧，想买点东西时，又会去另一个网站先比比价。

questions.en: What have you learned from websites that help with your life or studies?
questions.zh: 你在网上学到了哪些对生活或学习有帮助的东西？
questions.sample: I've learned how to mend a sketchbook when the cover comes loose. A short illustrated guide showed me where to place the tape so the pages still open flat.
questions.sampleZh: 我在网上学会了速写本封面松了怎么修。有一篇简短的图文教程告诉我胶带该贴在哪儿，这样本子修好了还能平摊开来。

questions.en: How have websites helped you in your work or studies?
questions.zh: 网站对你的工作或学习提供过什么帮助？
questions.sample: Online library catalogues save me a wasted trip when a book is already on loan. I can reserve it before class and collect it later, once it comes back.
questions.sampleZh: 图书馆的在线目录能让我提前知道书是不是借出去了，省得白跑一趟。我可以上课前先预约，等书还回来再去取。

questions.en: Is there a website that you use a lot in your free time?
questions.zh: 有没有一个你在空闲时经常使用的网站？
questions.sample: I often use a video website to look up recipes. I like being able to pause at the exact moment a cook shows how thick a sauce should be.
questions.sampleZh: 我常去视频网站找菜谱。我特别喜欢的一点是，厨师示范酱汁要熬到多稠的时候，我可以刚好按暂停，看个清楚。

questions.en: Did you have a favourite teacher at school?
questions.zh: 你上学时有特别喜欢的老师吗？
questions.sample: Yes, my art teacher. She could look at a half-finished drawing and ask just one question that helped me see what I wanted to change.
questions.focusWording: Who was your favourite teacher?
questions.sampleZh: 有，是我的美术老师。她看着一幅还没画完的画，只要问一个问题，就常能帮我看清自己究竟想改哪儿。
questions.sampleNote: 可用任意熟悉的学校科目和老师作例子。

questions.en: In what way has your favourite teacher helped you?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢的老师在哪些方面帮助过你？
questions.sample: She encouraged me to keep old sketches instead of throwing them away. Seeing an early attempt next to a later one made my progress much easier to notice.
questions.sampleZh: 她鼓励我把旧草图留着，别急着丢。早期的尝试和后来画的版本放在一起，我就更容易看到自己进步在哪里。

questions.en: Are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?
questions.zh: 你还和小学老师保持联系吗？
questions.sample: Not regularly. I remember a few of them very fondly, but it's easier to stay in touch with teachers who taught me more recently.
questions.sampleZh: 不常联系。有几位老师我现在想起来还是觉得很亲切，不过我更容易和后来才教过我的老师保持联系。

questions.en: Do you have a teacher from your past that you still remember?
questions.zh: 以前教过你的老师中，有哪位让你至今还记得？
questions.sample: I still remember an art teacher who brought ordinary objects into class for us to study. A spoon could keep us busy for ages once we noticed the different reflections.
questions.sampleZh: 我还记得一位美术老师，她会把日常小物件带到课堂上让我们观察。只要开始留意勺子上的不同反光，一把勺子就够我们研究好久。

questions.en: Do you want to be a teacher in the future?
questions.zh: 你以后想当老师吗？
questions.sample: I might enjoy teaching a beginners' drawing class. The fun part would be showing someone how a simple shape can become a picture they recognise.
questions.sampleZh: 我可能会喜欢教初学者画画。能让一个人看到，一个简单的形状也能画成自己认得的图案，这一点会很有意思。

questions.en: Who did you like more, your primary school teachers or your secondary school teachers?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢小学老师还是中学老师？
questions.sample: I felt closer to my secondary school teachers because I had a better idea of what I liked. That made it easier to ask them for advice about classes and practical skills.
questions.focusWording: Which do you prefer, primary school teachers or high school teachers?
questions.sampleZh: 我和中学老师感觉更亲近，因为那时我更清楚自己喜欢什么。所以无论想问选课，还是问某项实用技能，我都更容易开口向他们请教。

questions.en: Do you think teaching is a good job?
questions.zh: 你觉得当老师是份好工作吗？
questions.sample: Yes, if you enjoy working with people. It takes patience to explain the same idea in several ways, but seeing a student finally understand it must feel rewarding.
questions.focusWording: Do you think teaching is a good job?
questions.sampleZh: 如果你喜欢和人打交道，我觉得是的。用好几种方法解释同一个意思需要耐心，不过看着学生终于弄懂，一定很有成就感。

questions.en: Are you still in contact with any of your teachers?
questions.zh: 你还和以前教过你的老师保持联系吗？
questions.sample: Occasionally. I sometimes send an old teacher a picture of something I finally managed to make, especially if I used a technique they first showed me.
questions.sampleZh: 偶尔会联系。我有时终于做出一样东西，就会拍张照片发给以前的老师，尤其是用上了当年那位老师教给我的做法时。

questions.en: Do you think teachers are different now than when you were a student?
questions.zh: 你觉得现在的老师和你自己还在上学时的老师有不同吗？
questions.sample: In some ways, yes. Teachers have more digital tools now, but the teachers I remember best were good at noticing a confused student, and a screen can't do that for them.
questions.focusWording: Do you think teachers are different now than when you were a student?
questions.sampleZh: 有些方面是的。现在老师能用的数字工具更多了，不过我记得最牢的那些老师，都很善于发现哪个学生没听懂，在这一点上，屏幕替代不了他们。

questions.en: Did you like going to parks as a child?
questions.zh: 你小时候喜欢去公园吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially a little neighbourhood park where other children would gather after school. We didn't need much equipment to turn an empty patch of ground into a game.
questions.focusWording: Did you like going to parks as a child?
variants: Was there a park or garden you liked to play in when you were a child?
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢家附近的那个小公园，放学后总有其他孩子在那里。我们不需要什么装备，找块空地就能玩起游戏。

questions.en: Do you enjoy visiting parks and gardens now?
questions.zh: 你现在喜欢逛公园和花园吗？
questions.sample: Yes, particularly after a long day of reading. A short walk in a park gives my eyes a rest, and I usually come back in a better mood.
questions.focusWording: Do you still like going to parks now?
questions.sampleZh: 喜欢，尤其是看了一整天书以后。去公园走一小圈能让眼睛歇一歇，我回来的时候，心情通常也会好一点。

questions.en: Would you like to have more parks and gardens in your area?
questions.zh: 你希望附近有更多公园和花园吗？
questions.sample: Definitely, especially small ones within walking distance. A beautiful park across town is nice, but a green space I can visit between study sessions is more useful to me.
questions.focusWording: Would you like to see more parks in your city?
questions.sampleZh: 当然，尤其是那些走路就能到的小公园。城市另一头有座漂亮公园固然很好，但对我来说，学习间隙就能去走走的绿地更实用。

questions.en: Is there a famous park or garden you would like to visit in the future?
questions.zh: 你以后特别想去哪个有名的公园或花园？
questions.sample: I'd like to visit a well-known botanical garden with a large glasshouse. Drawing a plant I've never seen before sounds like a good way to remember the visit.
questions.focusWording: Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
questions.sampleZh: 我想去逛一座有大型温室的知名植物园。画下一株从没见过的植物，听起来是个记住这次参观的好办法。

questions.en: Would you prefer to play in a private garden or a public garden?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢在私人花园还是公共花园里玩？
questions.sample: I'd choose a public garden most of the time. I like seeing what other people are doing, and I can enjoy the trees without having to look after them.
questions.sampleZh: 大多数时候，我会选公共花园。我喜欢看看别人在做什么，还能欣赏树木，又不用自己照料。

questions.en: How are the parks today different from those you visited as a kid?
questions.zh: 现在的公园和你小时候去过的公园有什么不同？
questions.sample: The parks I visit now seem to have more exercise equipment and clear walking paths. As a child, I mostly noticed whether there was somewhere to run or play.
questions.sampleZh: 我现在常去的公园好像有更多健身器材，步道也更清晰。小时候我主要留意的是有没有地方能跑一跑、玩一玩。

questions.en: What do you like to do when visiting a park?
questions.zh: 去公园时，你喜欢做什么？
questions.sample: I like walking slowly and then finding a bench. If I'm with a friend, it's a good place for a proper conversation because neither of us is rushing to order anything.
questions.sampleZh: 我喜欢慢慢散步，再找张长椅坐下。如果是和朋友一起，这里就很适合好好聊聊天，因为我们谁都不用急着点什么东西。

questions.en: Would you like to play in a public garden or park?
questions.zh: 你愿意去公共花园或公园玩吗？
questions.sample: Yes, I'd happily bring a friend and play a casual game there. I prefer something simple like badminton that doesn't need a court booking or much equipment.
questions.sampleZh: 愿意，我很乐意叫上一个朋友去那里随便玩玩。我更喜欢羽毛球这种简单的运动，不用预约场地，也不需要带很多装备。

questions.en: Do you like looking in mirrors? How often?
questions.zh: 你喜欢照镜子吗？多久照一次？
questions.sample: I use one a couple of times a day, usually before going out. I just check my hair and whether there's anything on my face, then I'm done.
questions.sampleZh: 我一天会照上两三次，通常是出门前。看看头发，再看看脸上有没有沾东西，这就行了。

questions.en: Have you ever bought mirrors?
questions.zh: 你买过镜子吗？
questions.sample: Yes, a small one for my desk. It's handy before a video call because I can check quickly without opening the camera and getting distracted by my phone.
questions.sampleZh: 买过，买了一面小镜子放在书桌上。视频通话前看一眼很方便，不用打开手机相机，也免得顺手玩起手机分了心。

questions.en: Do you usually take a mirror with you?
questions.zh: 你平常随身带镜子吗？
questions.sample: Usually not. If I really need to check my appearance when I'm out, my phone camera is good enough, so I save the space in my bag.
questions.sampleZh: 通常不带。出门时如果真想看看自己的仪表，用手机相机就够了，还能给包里腾点地方。

questions.en: Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?
questions.zh: 你会用镜子装饰自己的房间吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially in a small room. A mirror opposite a bright wall can make a space feel lighter, although I wouldn't want one facing my study desk.
questions.sampleZh: 会，尤其是在小房间里。把镜子放在明亮的墙面对面，会显得整个空间更亮堂，不过我不想让镜子正对着自己的书桌。

questions.en: Do you prefer sad or happy music?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢伤感的音乐还是欢快的音乐？
questions.sample: I usually choose happy music, particularly when I need a little energy. A sad song can be lovely, but I don't often want one first thing in the morning.
questions.sampleZh: 我通常选欢快的音乐，尤其是想让自己精神一点的时候。伤感的歌也可以很好听，不过我一般不想一大早就听。

questions.en: Does happy music make you feel more excited?
questions.zh: 欢快的音乐会让你更兴奋吗？
questions.sample: Yes, especially if it has a clear beat. I sometimes put one on before I go out, and suddenly getting ready feels much less like a chore.
questions.sampleZh: 会，特别是节奏鲜明的歌。我有时会在出门前放一首，本来觉得收拾出门挺麻烦的，听着听着就觉得轻松多了。

questions.en: Do you listen to music while doing other things?
questions.zh: 你会边做别的事边听音乐吗？
